title: Commanders to hire Ben Steele as their TE coach

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Commanders to hire Ben Steele as their TE coach
sources.description: The Commanders are promoting tight ends coach David Raih to pass game coordinator and they've found a new position coach to take over his former role on Dan Quinn's staff.
